Aaron (AE): Heads up  LargeBank POC is failing validator checks on our fn_call output. CISO asked for immediate remediation and a short justification for why this happened.

Nina (SE): Can you share the raw failing sample and headers?

Aaron (AE): Customer provided a scrubbed proxy extract: 

```
2026-05-06T08:45:12Z upstream 422 validation_error
x-req-id=lb-900 body="{\"fn_call\":\"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"uploadReport\\\",\\\"arguments\\\":\\\"{\\\\\\\"report_id\\\\\\\":\\\\\\\"r-900\\\\\\\"}\\\"}\"}"
```

Sana (ML Eng): That looks like the `arguments` field was emitted as a quoted string. When the downstream schema validator expects an object it rejects. Suspect combination: function_call=auto + json_mode=true + streaming=true.

Diego (Infra): We also see repeated retries in their logs. If the gateway re-sends the same bad payload multiple times it increases error noise. Ask them to include X-Request-ID header so we can correlate.

Nina (SE): Short mitigation options for customer: 
1) Call with `function_call: explicit` and `json_mode: relaxed` temporarily, or
2) We enable a tenant-scoped sanitizer that detects top-level quoted JSON in fn_call.arguments and unescapes it before forwarding.

Aaron (AE): They want a quick mitigation and will consider Dedicated if this is persistent (per-tenant KMS + static egress). CISO asked for KMS details.

Sana (ML Eng): For root cause: when streaming flushes partial tokens and the function_call serializer is in auto mode we sometimes wrap the arguments as a string to avoid premature parse errors. We should change runtime to prefer emitting an object token when json_mode is true. Filed INF-7810.

Diego (Infra): I can roll a tenant rule (staged) to run the unescape sanitizer for largebank-01. Need approval on payload mutation audit. infra-bot: creating trace...

infra-bot: Trace created at https://traces.internal/lb-900. Rule staging id=stg-912.

Nina (SE): I'll draft a 1-paragraph non-technical explanation for the CISO: cause, temporary mitigation, and timeline for a permanent fix. Will post here for review.

Aaron (AE): Please add a short note about logs and KMS: we support cloud KMS and HSM-backed keys for Dedicated; control plane logs redact request bodies by default.

Sana (ML Eng): If sanitizer fixes it in staging, we should push it to prod as a hotfix and concurrently implement INF-7810 in the runtime so the behavior never happens again.

Diego (Infra): Rolling the staging sanitizer now. Will monitor for unescape events and false positives; will only target tenant largebank-01.

Aaron (AE): Thanks team. Customer will retest at 10am ET. I'll update once they confirm.
